summary.text: Vincent Mendes III is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Katie Dempsey.
A chiropractor in Northwest Georgia, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he chairs the Floyd County Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Vincent Mendes III's career experience includes working as a chiropractor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has cared for patients in Northwest Georgia for years, has raised three daughters there with his wife, and chairs the Floyd County Democratic Party.
Mendes advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In the survey, he said no one else had stepped forward to run for the district and that he decided to do so with his wife.
His listed campaign priorities include setting state guidelines for new data centers, economic growth that creates well-paying jobs, and road infrastructure in Rome and Floyd County.
